title: Accounts Assistant (some hybrid)
description:
Our client are seeking a reliable and detail-driven Accounts Assistant with strong all-round experience across sales ledger, purchase ledger, and bank reconciliations. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety and wants to play a key role in a busy finance team.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the sales ledger, including raising invoices, allocating payments, and resolving customer queries.
- Handle purchase ledger duties such as processing supplier invoices, matching to POs, coding, and preparing payment runs.
- Complete daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies promptly.
- Maintain accurate financial records and support month-end processes.
- Assist with supplier statement reconciliations and aged debtor/creditor reviews.
- Provide general administrative and finance support as required.

About You
- Experience across sales ledger, purchase ledger, and bank reconciliations is essential.
- Strong attention to detail with a proactive, organised approach.
- Confident using accounting software and Excel.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team.
- A positive attitude and willingness to support wider finance tasks when needed.

Benefits
- Flexible office hours (35 hour working week)
- 25 days holiday + stats
- Supportive working environment
- Opportunities for development
- Stable and varied role within a growing business

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a role where you can use your full range of skills, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Advanced Bookkeeper (On-site)
company: Canning Generator Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Advanced Bookkeeper (Part-Time)

Location: Widnes (Office Based)
Hours: 24 hours per week (3 days) 8am - 16:30pm
Salary: 32,000 - 36,000 FTE (Pro Rata)
Contract: Permanent

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Advanced Bookkeeper to join our growing team. Reporting to the Operations Manager and Fractional Finance Director, you will play a key role in managing the day-to-day financial operations of the business.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive finance professional who enjoys working independently while contributing to a wider team.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage sales ledger activities, including invoicing and credit control.
- Process supplier invoices, reconcile supplier accounts and maintain purchase ledger records.
- Prepare and process weekly supplier payment runs.
- Complete daily bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Monitor cash flow and maintain accurate financial records.
- Process monthly payroll, pension submissions and HMRC reporting.
- Prepare and submit VAT returns.
- Assist with month-end procedures, including balance sheet reconciliations.
- Support the preparation of management accounts.
- Maintain accurate accounting records within Xero.
- Ensure compliance with financial controls and company procedures.
- Liaise with HMRC, suppliers and other external stakeholders as required.
- Identify opportunities to improve finance processes and efficiencies.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- At least 5 years' bookkeeping or finance experience.
- Strong knowledge of bookkeeping principles and financial controls.
- Excellent working knowledge of Xero.
- Experience processing payroll and pension schemes.
- Good understanding of VAT and HMRC compliance requirements.
- Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- The ability to manage workloads independently and prioritise effectively.
- A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving.

Desirable
- AAT Level 3 or above.
- CIS knowledge and experience.
- Experience working in an SME environment.

What We Offer
- Flexible working hours, including consideration for school hours.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you're an experienced bookkeeper looking for a flexible role where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator
6 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Atrium Associates are delighted to be supporting the recruitment of a Finance Administrator on behalf of a growing and dynamic organisation. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy finance team on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with full-time hours preferred, although flexible working arrangements will be considered. The role can be offered on a remote, hybrid, or office-based basis, depending on experience and business requirements.

This position would suit an experienced Finance Administrator or Accounts Assistant, or someone currently studying towards their AAT qualification, who is looking to broaden their exposure across a range of transactional finance activities.

The Role

Working as part of a supportive finance function, you will provide administration and support across key finance processes including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and general finance operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Resolving unallocated customer payments
- Clearing aged supplier invoices
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations
- Processing purchase invoices
- Chasing outstanding customer payments and receipts
- Performing bank reconciliations
- Posting intercompany journals
- Managing employee expense runs
- Completing company credit card reconciliations
- Supporting wider finance administration activities as required
- Investigating and resolving discrepancies across accounts

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who possess:
- Previous experience within a finance administration, accounts, bookkeeping, or transactional finance role
- Experience posting journals and working within finance systems
- Strong reconciliation skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and investigating discrepancies
- Strong communication skills with the confidence to liaise with both suppliers and customers
- Good Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience using NetSuite would be advantageous but is not essential
- AAT studies or an aspiration to progress towards a finance qualification would be beneficial

What's on Offer?
- 6-month fixed-term contract
- Full-time position with flexibility around working hours
- Remote, hybrid, or office-based working options available
- Broad exposure across multiple finance disciplines
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Opportunity to develop valuable finance experience within a busy and varied role

If you are a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys reconciliation work, problem-solving, and ensuring financial information is accurate and up to date, we'd love to hear from you.

Atrium Associates look forward to discussing this opportunity with you.

Selina Gibbs (url removed)

title: Finance Assistant - Cost Control
description:
Finance Assistant Cost Control

Salary: £27,000 Runcorn, Cheshire Permanent Monday to Friday (40hrs per week) Office-based

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Finance Assistant Cost Control to join a growing finance team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger, Finance Administration or a similar transactional finance role who is looking for a stable long-term career.

Working closely with the Lead Cost Controller, you ll support the day-to-day running of the finance function, with responsibility for processing invoices, reconciling supplier accounts, investigating discrepancies and supporting payment processes.

As the finance function continues to develop, this is a varied role offering the opportunity to broaden your experience and gain exposure to cost control, subcontractor administration and wider finance processes.

About the Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing a high volume of cost of sales, agency and supplier invoices, ensuring these are accurate and processed within agreed timescales.
- Completing 3-way matching between purchase orders, goods received notes and invoices.
- Managing the Accounts Department inbox and responding to supplier queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Completing regular supplier statement reconciliations and investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Assisting with the investigation and resolution of aged items on the GRNI report.
- Processing monthly credit card reconciliations and staff expense claims.
- Supporting the Lead Cost Controller with information and validation for weekly BACS payment runs.
- Assisting with the accurate filing and tracking of subcontractor documentation, including administrative support relating to CIS and retention tracking.
- Supporting data cleansing and general finance administration as part of ongoing systems and ERP development.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring processes are completed in line with company procedures.
- Providing general support to the wider finance team as required.

About You

We re looking for someone who is organised, reliable and detail-focused, with a genuine interest in a long-term stable career.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within an accounts/finance or administrative role.
- AAT part-qualified or currently studying would be advantageous.
- A good understanding of basic accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping.
- An understanding of invoice processing.
- Good Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with financial information.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work.
- Good communication skills, with the confidence to deal with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively to deadlines.
- A proactive approach and the confidence to investigate queries, identify discrepancies and find solutions.

What's on Offer?
- £27,000 salary
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday (40 hrs per week)
- Fully office-based (Runcorn, Cheshire)
- A varied role within an evolving finance function
- The opportunity to work closely with an experienced Lead Cost Controller and develop your finance skills

title: Payroll and HR Administrator
description:
As a Payroll and People Administrator you will ensure the smooth running of payroll processes, from handling payroll queries to maintaining accurate records working with contacts across HR and Finance.

Client Details

In this role, you'll support the delivery of an accurate, compliant and efficient payroll service for a large workforce. Working closely with colleagues across HR, Finance and operational teams, you'll play a key part in ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time while maintaining high standards of payroll administration and customer service.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with payroll experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to develop their career within payroll and HR operations.

Description
- Provide first-line support and guidance to employees and managers on payroll-related queries including pay, tax, National Insurance, policies and employment terms.
- Process and validate monthly payroll data, including time sheets, expenses and employee changes.
- Support the administration of starters, leavers, transfers, contractual changes and salary amendments.
- Assist with statutory and occupational payments including sickness, maternity, paternity and adoption pay.
- Support payroll compliance activities, including HMRC documentation and year-end payroll processes.
- Assist with pension administration and employee benefit schemes.
- Produce payroll reports and support data analysis as required.
- Maintain accurate employee and payroll records, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.
- Contribute to payroll, HR and systems improvement projects.
- Provide administrative support and maintain effective filing and record-keeping systems.
- Build strong working relationships with colleagues across HR, Finance and other business functions.

Profile

A successful Payroll and People Administrator should have:
- Experience in processing payroll within a professional setting.
- Knowledge of payroll and HR integrated systems
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
- Good communication and problem-solving abilities.

Job Offer
- £28,000 - £33,000
- Warrington town centre
- Family friendly, flexible start and finish time
- Hybrid working arrangements to suit you
- Rolling temporary contract with 37.5 working hours per week.
- Hourly pay plus holiday pay

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Warrington, you will handle day-to-day accounting tasks within the retail business, helping to keep financial records accurate and up to date. You will work as part of the Accounting & Finance department and provide reliable administrative support that helps the team run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Warrington.

Description

Key Responsibilities
- Processing invoices: Managing and recording supplier and customer invoices.
- Reconciliation: Balancing accounts by reconciling bank statements and financial transactions.
- Data entry: Inputting financial data into accounting systems, ensuring accuracy.
- Expense claims: Processing employee expense claims and ensuring compliance with company policies.
- Credit control: Assisting with managing outstanding payments and debt collection.
- Making daily payments: Processing payments to suppliers and other creditors, ensuring timely and accurate transfers.
- VAT returns: Assisting in preparing VAT returns and other tax documentation.
- Supporting the Head of Finance: Providing administrative and financial support, including helping with audits, financial analysis, budgeting and forecasting tasks.
- Providing administrative support across payroll, HR and office operations, including maintaining records, supporting business processes and assisting with ad hoc projects and administrative activities as directed by the Head of Finance and General Manager.

Profile
- Experience in an accounts assistant or similar finance role.
- Strong numerical skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (e.g., Sage, Xero, QuickBooks).
- Knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, credit control and payroll processing.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an excellent telephone manner.
- Highly organised with strong multi-tasking skills and ability to work under strict deadlines.
- A proactive, methodical and self-motivated approach to work.
- Accuracy and attention to detail, comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced environment.
- Flexible approach to work, especially during peak periods.
- Willingness to support wider business functions including payroll, HR administration and office operations.
- Ability to build effective working relationships and act as a trusted support to the Head of Finance and wider management team.
- Strong commercial awareness with a confident and determined attitude.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- Must be able to commute to Birchwood, Warrington.

Job Offer
- Permanent Accounts Assistant position based in Birchwood.
- Salary of 31,000 to 33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Start anytime between 8am and 9am
- 25 days holidays plus BH

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant

- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Coding invoices and posting them onto the purchase ledger.

- Maintaining accurate supplier account records and master data.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

- Contact customers regarding outstanding payments.

- Previous experience in Credit Control or Accounts Receivable.
- Good understanding of credit control processes.
- Strong communication and numerical skills.
- Good Excel skills; SAP experience is desirable.

- Confident working independently and as part of a team.

title: HR / Payroll Assistant
description:
Are you an ambitious HR, Business, or Accounting graduate looking to kick-start your career in HR, Payroll, or similar?

Or perhaps you already have some initial exposure to HR systems, payroll, or benefits administration and want to continue your professional development?

We are looking for a enthusiastic junior payroll and benefits person to join a supportive HR team on a fixed-term contract until November 2027.

This hybrid role is working 1 day in the Liverpool office per week, 2 days in the Warrington office and 2 days working from home. Paying a salary of £27,783

This is a fantastic entry-to-mid-level stepping stone where you ll learn the ropes of payroll and benefits while helping deliver a brilliant service to colleagues across the business.

What You ll Be Doing:
- Act as a friendly first point of contact for colleagues and managers, helping resolve everyday pay, pension, and benefit queries.
- Assist with administering pension schemes, employee benefits, mileage claims, and handling new starters, leavers, and contractual changes.
- Process payroll and reward data with strong attention to detail, ensuring everything is accurate, confidential, and on time.
- Bring your fresh ideas! Help review and streamline processes to make our people services even better.
- Support year-end activities, audits, and wider wellbeing and reward initiatives.

What We re Looking For:
- Ideally an HR, Business, or Accounting/Finance graduate, or someone with early practical experience in a payroll, pensions, reward, or busy HR administration environment.
- Good IT skills, a head for numbers, and top-tier attention to detail.
- Warm, professional communication skills with a natural customer-first attitude.
- Able to manage your workload, meet deadlines, and commit to the hybrid working pattern across our Liverpool and Warrington offices (a driving licence/access to a vehicle is a bonus!).
- GCSE Maths and English (Level 4/C or equivalent).

If you are eager to learn, enjoy working with data and people, and want to build a fantastic foundation in Reward and Payroll, then we d love to hear from you! Apply today!
